sources.title: Busshållplatser Gävle Central (PDF of 2025-08-18, X-trafik/Region Gävleborg)
sources.note: Supplied by the owner; used to check the tunnel, lifts, stairs and track numbers and to place the two toilets (placed by fitting the plan's lifts to OSM's; about 5 m accuracy). Not ODbL; see data/stations/README.md.

Jernhusen's list of places at the station with opening hours (WHSmith's and Järnvägskrogen's hours from it). It also names Subway and Habesha Restaurang Bar, which no source places, so they aren't on the map; Bistro Nord (OSM, no date) isn't on it and is left out. Toilet page: toilet and accessible toilet, card payment.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000210).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract, with its multipolygon platforms), checked against the region's Gävle Central plan (2025-08-18): three tunnel lifts, two flights of stairs and the tunnel's south end joined by hand; bridge pieces of the platforms left out; toilets placed from the plan; WHSmith's and Järnvägskrogen's hours from Jernhusen (2026-10-22); Bistro Nord, not on Jernhusen's list, removed.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 50 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000210).
